name: getElementById()
notes: Returns the element with the specified id

name: querySelector()
notes: Returns the first element matching a CSS selector; owner context must be preserved

name: querySelectorAll()
notes: Returns a static NodeList matching a CSS selector

name: getElementsByClassName()
notes: Returns a live HTMLCollection of matching descendant elements

name: getElementsByTagName()
notes: Returns elements by tag name

name: createElement()
notes: Creates an Element node

name: createTextNode()
notes: Creates a Text node

name: appendChild()
notes: Adds a node as the last child of a parent node

name: removeChild()
notes: Removes a specified child node

name: replaceChild()
notes: Replaces a child node

name: setAttribute()
notes: Sets or changes an attribute value

name: getAttribute()
notes: Returns an attribute value

name: removeAttribute()
notes: Removes an attribute from an element

name: hasAttribute()
notes: Returns whether the element has the specified attribute

name: addEventListener()
notes: Registers an event listener; separate owner contexts retained

name: removeEventListener()
notes: Removes a previously registered event listener

name: classList
notes: Returns the DOMTokenList of class tokens

name: className
notes: Gets or sets the class attribute

name: textContent
notes: Gets or sets text content of a node and descendants

name: innerHTML
notes: Gets or sets parsed markup; content insertion requires security review

name: parentElement
notes: Returns the parent element

name: children
notes: Returns child elements, excluding text and comment nodes

name: nextElementSibling
notes: Returns the next sibling element

name: previousElementSibling
notes: Returns the previous sibling element

name: closest()
notes: Returns the closest ancestor matching a CSS selector

name: matches()
notes: Tests whether the element matches a CSS selector

name: focus()
notes: Sets focus on an element

name: blur()
notes: Removes focus from an element

name: preventDefault()
notes: Cancels the default action when the event is cancelable

name: stopPropagation()
notes: Stops further propagation of the current event
